grades: High school (students stay until they graduate)
pay_detail: Free. Federally funded TRIO program. No stipend is mentioned on the pages read.
name: TRIO Upward Bound at Waubonsee Community College
city: Aurora, IL (East and West Aurora High Schools)
what_you_do: Free college prep at school. It includes study hall, tutoring, workshops and college visits. You get help with applications. You also explore careers and get internship chances. There is an optional 6 week summer program at the Sugar Grove campus.
who_can_apply: Students at East Aurora High School or West Aurora High School only. The pages read do not list income or first-generation rules, so ask the staff.
deadline_text: The application page still showed 2024-25, with applications opening August 1, 2024. No current deadline is posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the new student application (from your counselor, Room 201 at East or A104A at West, or the website). Staff then set up a family interview, and new students do a 10 to 60 day trial period. Email upwardbound@waubonsee.edu.
notes: The form asks for copies of your transcript and birth certificate. It also asks for your Social Security card and a parent tax return. Give these only to program staff at the school or the Sugar Grove office.
